Overview.Name: Panasa Swathi
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable oats (60 g) + mixed nuts (10 g)
Option 3: Poha (80 g) with peanuts (10 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + fish curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Millet pulao (150 g) + mixed veg (100 g)
Option 3: Chapati (2) + chicken curry (120 g) + vegetable side (80 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + 1 chapati
Option 2: Grilled fish (100 g) + steamed veggies (100 g)
Option 3: Mixed vegetable stir-fry (150 g) (choose preferred vegetables)

Notes_and_Tips: Manage thyroid under physician guidance; include selenium and iodine sources if advised.
Prefer balanced plates with protein, fiber and healthy fats.
Avoid high-sugar and highly processed foods to stabilise energy.
When Meals_per_Day=2 focus on later meals and keep breakfast light.
Maintain consistent sleep patterns to support metabolic health.
If you dislike vegetables, start with small portions and choose milder options (bottle gourd, ridge gourd, carrot, cucumber).
